product.name: Denso Anti Corrosion Tape - 10m x 75mm - Waterproof Pipe Repair & Corrosion Protection Tape for Oil - Gas & Water Pipework
product.description:
Introduction:
The Denso Anti Corrosion Tape 10m x 75mm is a durable protective tape designed for long-term corrosion protection and waterproof sealing on pipework, fittings, valves, and flanges. Suitable for both buried and exposed applications, it forms a strong moisture barrier while remaining flexible in use. Resistant to mineral acids, alkalis, salts, and bacterial attack, it is ideal for plumbing, industrial, and utility applications.

Features & Benefits:
Anti-Corrosion Protection – Helps prevent corrosion on metal pipework and fittings
Waterproof Sealing – Creates a strong barrier against moisture and water ingress
10m x 75mm Size – Suitable for a wide range of repair and protection tasks
Flexible & Durable – Maintains flexibility for long-lasting performance
Buried & Exposed Use – Suitable for underground and above-ground pipework
Chemical Resistant – Resistant to acids, alkalis, salts, and bacteria
Temporary Repair Use – Ideal for sealing leaks and fractured mains
Long Service Life – Designed for reliable, long-term protection
Conforms to BGC/PS/CW2 – Meets industry standards

Suitable for sealing and protecting:
Oil, gas & water pipework
Buried and exposed pipes
Pipe fittings, valves & flanges
Leaking connectors and waste pipes
Fractured mains (temporary repair)
Industrial and utility systems

Specifications:
Product Type: Anti-Corrosion & Waterproofing Tape
Brand: Denso
Length: 10 Metres
Width: 75mm
Application: Corrosion Protection & Sealing
Suitable For: Oil, Gas & Water Pipework
Standard: BGC/PS/CW2
Use: Buried & Exposed Applications

Package Contents:
1 × Denso Anti Corrosion Tape – 10m x 75mm

Why Choose Denso Anti Corrosion Tape?
The Denso Anti Corrosion Tape provides reliable protection and sealing for pipework in plumbing, construction, and industrial environments. Its flexible design allows easy application around pipes and joints, forming a durable barrier against moisture and corrosion.

product.name: FittingsCo, Soft Close Pull Out Wire Basket for Kitchen Cabinets, Polished Chrome, 30kg Capacity, 600mm
product.description: A high quality, very popular wire base pull-out, soft-closing basket system. Best suited to kitchen cabinets, these baskets provide easy access to cabinets with 30kg weight capacity and a sturdy wire base - perfect for dishware, pans, tins etc. PLEASE MEASURE PRIOR TO ORDERING - GUIDE BELOW: An easy way to do this is to measure your cabinet from outside edge to outside edge (imagine if the entire cabinet has been pulled out and is standing alone from the other cabinets - you would measure the full width). This should give a measurement to the nearest hundred i.e. 300mm, 400mm, 500mm or 600mm. If your cabinet measures anything higher than 900mm, 450mm or anything else - these baskets will not fit without additional packing out either side. Then measure the internal width (inside edge to inside edge). This should be around 36mm less than the full width. For example - a 600mm cabinet internal width should be around 564mm (600-36). This is based off industry standard 18mm thick board being used to construct your cabinet. The baskets themselves will have a width of around 100-110mm less than the full cabinet width. For example - a basket to suit a 600mm cabinet will be around 490mm. The rest of the width is made up from the runners either side up to the 564mm (with some adjustment available in the runners). 300mm Basket Sizing: To suit 300mm External Cabinet Size (260-270mm Internal Size) Depth 440mm, Height 140mm. 400mm Basket Sizing: To suit 400mm External Cabinet Size (360-370mm Internal Size) Depth 440mm, Height 140mm. 500mm Basket Sizing: To suit 500mm External Cabinet Size (460-470mm Internal Size) Depth 440mm, Height 140mm. 600mm Basket Sizing: To suit 600mm External Cabinet Size (560-570mm Internal Size) Depth 440mm, Height 140mm.

The Water Regulations Advisory Scheme is a certification mark that demonstrates that an item complies with the high standards set out by water regulations. product.name: Valiant Remora Magnetic Flue Pipe Fan, Moisture Meter and Magnetic Thermometer
product.description: Ideal for Inset Stoves or Stoves with limited clearance, our Remora Stove Fan attaches to your Flue Pipe using the powerful magnetic clamp. It then disperses heat throughout your room ensuring all areas are warm in no time. Available with your choice of Red or Green Thermometer which shows you the ideal temperature to burn your logs. This pack includes a Green Magnetic Thermometer.  The thermometer monitors your stove temperature to optimise performance and protects your stove from overheating. It also clearly displays the temperature of your stove, enabling you to maintain a safe and efficient operating temperature and reduce fuel consumption.  Use the handy Valiant Moisture meter to ensure you get the best burn from your fuel. Our newest model not only has a backlight screen to illuminate the reading but the built-in colour change technology indicates the moisture level of the firewood. It’s an essential tool for any fireplace owner!  Fuel quality is the single most important aspect of making a successful fire. To burn effectively the moisture content of firewood needs to be less than 20%, whether it’s being used in an open fire or a stove. Freshly felled timber can have a moisture content of between 30% and 60%, which when burnt can cause dangerous creosote build-up in chimneys. Using a moisture meter is a great way to check whether your wood will give you a safe and efficient burn, or if it needs further seasoning. The screen will glow green if your fuel contains less than 20% moisture, indicating that it’s ready to go. The new Valiant moisture meter can also be used in timber, floors and buildings in order to detect and measure moisture content.

product.name: Valiant Remora Magnetic Flue Pipe Fan, Moisture Meter and Magnetic Thermometer
product.description: The Remora is a powerful warm air circulating stove fan that features a strong magnetic clamp to attach to your flue pipe as opposed to sitting on your stove top. This means you can use it with any type of stove, regardless of the shape, size, or temperature of the top surface. It also means you can avoid the risk of damaging your stove fan by placing it too close to the fire. The fan is perfect for stoves that have a cool top, such as gas stoves, pellet stoves, or electric stoves. It can also work with stoves that have an irregular surface, such as cast-iron stoves, or a soapstone or angled top, such as Scandinavian stoves. The magnetic clamp allows you to adjust the position and angle of the fan to suit your flue pipe and optimize the airflow. The Magnetic Stove Thermometer in this pack monitors your stove temperature to optimise performance and protects your stove from overheating. It also clearly displays the temperature of your stove, enabling you to maintain a safe and efficient operating temperature and reduce fuel consumption. Place the Thermometer on the top, front, or side of a flat or curved surface. The built-in magnet will maintain its hold on steel up to temperatures of around 800°F (425°C). The optimum position is on the flue collar, or if not practical, as close to the collar as possible for a stable reliable place for monitoring the stove and flue gas temperature. This thermometer is suitable for use with most vitreous enamel, iron or steel flue pipes. For stainless steel flue applications do not attempt to fix to flue pipe, attach to the stove collar or place on the stove top.

product.name: Valiant Magnetic Flue Pipe Stove Fan and Thermometer
product.description:
Ideal for Inset Stoves or Stoves with limited clearance, our Remora Stove Fan attaches to your Flue Pipe using the powerful magnetic clamp. It then disperses heat throughout your room ensuring all areas are warm in no time. 

Featuring a powerful magnetic clamp that can withstand temperatures over 400°c, the Remora can quickly and easily attach to almost any Flue Pipe (4-7”) with magnetic attraction.* Once in place, the Stove Fan will automatically kick in as soon as your Flue Pipe warms up. With a starting temperature as low as 50°C, the Remora will soon be distributing warm air silently and effortlessly throughout any living space in which it is situated.

*A very small number of Flue Pipes are made from Stainless Steel and as such will not support the magnetic clamp. Please check your flue pipe attracts magnets prior to ordering the Remora. A simple fridge magnet will identify whether or not your Flue Pipe is sufficiently magnetic.

The set also includes a magnetic thermometer which will help protect your stove from overheating.

The magnetic Thermometer clearly displays the temperature of your stove, enabling you to maintain a safe and efficient operating temperature and reduce fuel consumption.

The robust design and strong magnet of the Stove Thermometer means that it’s suitable for use on any hot steel or iron surface, including stoves, BBQ, range cookers, patio heaters, flue pipes or chimeneas.

product.description: MDPE elbow fittings are designed for use with water supply pipes and come in a range of sizes, including 20mm, 25mm, 32mm, 40mm, and 50mm. These fittings are made from high-quality MDPE (medium-density polyethylene) material, which makes them strong, durable, and resistant to impact and corrosion. They are suitable for use in a variety of applications, including domestic and commercial plumbing, irrigation, and other water supply systems. The elbow shape of these fittings allows for easy changes in direction of the water supply pipes, making them ideal for use in tight spaces where straight pipe runs are not possible. They are easy to install and connect to the water supply pipes using compression fittings or push-fit connections. MDPE elbow fittings are suitable for use with both cold and hot water supply systems, and they can withstand high pressures and temperatures. They are also resistant to chemicals, UV radiation, and environmental stresses, making them suitable for use in harsh outdoor environments. Overall, MDPE elbow fittings are a reliable and versatile choice for anyone looking for durable and easy-to-use fittings for their water supply systems.

product.name: Aquarius Foundry 6 Column Horizontal Radiator in White -  600 X 605
product.description:
The Aquarius Bathrooms Foundry 6 Column Horizontal Radiator delivers a substantial heating solution designed to establish a comforting presence at the heart of your home. With a 6 column arrangement, this horizontal radiator sits neatly beneath window frames or along principal walls to create an inviting focal point.

A white radiator is a versatile choice that sits in perfect harmony alongside the organic textures of wooden floors and soft woven fabrics. It blends seamlessly into gentle colour scheme, allowing the surrounding decorations to take centre stage. Alternatively, for homes with bold design choices, the angled aesthetics provides a striking geometric contrast against darker walls, adding a modern edge that coordinates beautifully with plush carpets and contemporary furnishings. This adaptability makes it a grounding piece that effortlessly ties an entire room together, regardless of how your personal style evolves over the years.

Why Choose a 6 Column Radiator?

A 6 column radiator is constructed with six distinct rows of vertical tubing engineered into every section. This creates an exceptionally deep, thick profile that packs a massive amount of metal surface area into a compact wall footprint.

By holding a significantly higher volume of hot water and metal mass, it offers an outstanding heat output capacity and accelerated warm up times. This makes it the premier choice for making expansive open plan family zones, grand hallways, high-ceiling conversions, or naturally drafty spaces feel genuinely cozy and snug.

Please note: This radiator operates on standard central heating networks. Radiator valves and legs are sold separately, giving you the creative freedom to select your own custom finishes to complete your space.

Refresh your bathroom with the 800mm Modern Pivot Bath Shower Glass Screen, a practical, stylish solution for combining the convenience of a shower with the comfort of a bath.

Guarantee - Lifetime
Fittings & fixings included

product.name: Terma Electric Radiator ROLO-ROOM E (Bluetooth) 1800h x 480w(mm) 1 Kw Brass
product.description: Terma oil filled electric radiator supplied with the Terma MOA Blue (bluetooth) heating element - smartphone controlled, fully thermostatic element and a round clock face style head. Full operational control on smartphone/tablet via Bluetooth (up to 10 metre range depending on your walls), with a choice of internal temp (30°c to 60°c) or ambient room temp (15°c to 30°c) regulation. Once programmed the element will remember settings when phone is not in Bluetooth range. 7 day Timer functionality. Also includes 2hr drying function whereby radiator will turn off automatically when time has elapsed. The Brass colour from Terma has a matt, metallic, smooth texture. This type of colour/finish is unique for electric radiators. Terma offers a 150x50mm colour chip of this finish should you wish to see the colour prior to purchase. The heating element will be provided separately in the box and simply needs screwing into place in the radiator at time of installing - can be fitted on the left or right side as preferred. The cable length is 1.5 metres. The Terma BlueLine app is free to download, available for IOS and ANDROID. Casing and cable on element will match the radiator colour (white/silver/black). IPx5 (safe for use in bathroom). Class 1. UKCA Approved. Trades can wire this in within 20-30 minutes. Note: The electric Rolo-Room-E is a portrait (vertical) radiator and cannot be installed horizontally, as it will not function correctly horizontally. Rolo is part of a unique family of products where you can buy matching radiators (electric and central heating), mirror radiators and towel rails.

product.name: Plum&Clay Ardor Grey Horizontal Radiator Smart Electric Panel Heater Plug- In Radiator (W) 947mm (H) 500mm
product.description:
Bring warmth and convenient control to your home with the Ardor Grey Horizontal Smart Electric Panel Heater. With a clean grey finish and a slim, wall-mounted design, this 1500W electric radiator offers practical heating without taking up valuable floor space.

Adjust the temperature from 7°C to 30°C to suit your comfort, and manage your heating through the Doodle Smart or Smart Life apps on iOS and Android. WiFi connectivity lets you control settings from your smartphone, while the weekly programming function makes it easy to create a heating schedule around your routine.

Choose from multiple operating modes, including Comfort, Holiday and Antifreeze, to suit your needs. Open window detection automatically adjusts heating to help reduce wasted energy, while the built-in child lock helps prevent accidental changes to your settings.

Designed for wall mounting with a plug-in electric connection, the Ardor combines everyday convenience with a neat, space-saving profile.

- Fitting: Wall mounted

product.name: Terma Electric Radiator ROLO-ROOM E (W-Fi) 2000h x 590w(mm) 1.5 Kw Heban Black
product.description: Terma oil filled electric radiator, with 40mm diamater bars, supplied with the Terma VEO Wi-Fi element controlled via the Terma SMART app (ios/android). Compatible with Alexa, Google Assistant and IFTTT. No hub is required as element will connect direct to the app via Wi-Fi. Requires a 2.4ghz wifi network to conect and setup the element (which may need to be switched on by your internet service provider) this can be turned off once connected. The Rolo Room E with VEO wifi controller offers between 1.0 kw and 2.0 kw of heat output (dependant on size chosen) so the perfect electric radiators for large open spaces. Offers 5 room temperature settings (15 to 28 °C), a Drying function and a full 7-day timer. The Smart system consists only of heating devices and sensors and no additional hub is required.Also fully compatible with Alexa, Google Assistant and IFTTT). The Heban Black colour from Terma has a matt, rough texture. This type of colour/finish is unique for electric radiators. Terma offers a 150x50mm colour chip of this finish should you wish to see the colour prior to purchase. The smart split (SS1) probe is pre fitted inside the raditaor on the right side (cannot be moved to left side). The VEO controller simply pushes on and can be rotated to view.  The clamshell casing on each element is in a matching or complimentary colour to the radiator. The controller comes pre fitted with a UK 3 pin plug for ease of installation next to an existing socket. The Terma SMART App includes geolocation to automatically lower the temperature by 3-4°C when you leave and return to comfort mode as you approach home. It offers a full 7-day timer, a 2-hour drying function with auto shut-off, and a holiday mode accessible via the app. Compliant with Lot20 Eco-design Directive for electric radiators with adaptive start control. Straight 1.5m cable, fitted with a UK 3 pin plug. IPx5 (safe for use in bathroom).Class 1. UKCA Approved. Guarantee: 2 Years.

product.name: SHPELEC 6mm Twin and Earth Cable 6242Y Grey, 2m - Cooker & Shower Circuit Wire, BASEC Approved
product.description:
SHPELEC 6242Y twin and earth cable, 6mm², supplied as one continuous 2m coil. Grey flat T&E for the fixed wiring of dedicated high-current circuits in the home, such as electric cookers, hobs and smaller electric showers.

Which size do you need? 6mm² is commonly used for cooker circuits and smaller electric showers. Larger showers, long cable runs or cable buried in insulation often need 10mm². Socket circuits normally use 2.5mm². Always size the cable from the circuit design or the appliance's installation instructions - never use a smaller size.

Construction: two 6mm² stranded copper conductors (brown and blue) and a 2.5mm² bare copper earth (CPC), PVC insulated with a grey PVC sheath. Max. overall size 7.8 x 15.0mm. Rated 300/500V; minimum operating temperature -15°C, maximum conductor temperature 70°C. Max. conductor resistance at 20°C: 3.08 ohm/km (brown and blue), 7.41 ohm/km (earth). BASEC approved and made to BS 6004.

Current rating: up to 47A clipped direct (BS 7671 reference method C). De-rate for other installation methods, grouping, thermal insulation and long runs.

Installation: fixed wiring in dry or damp locations - clip it to walls or joists, lay it on cable tray or run it in free air where it won't be damaged, and use conduit or trunking where it needs protecting. This is stiff fixed-wiring cable, not a flexible lead. Install only when the cable and the air are above 0°C. Sleeve the bare earth green/yellow at every termination.

In the box: 1 x 2m coil of 6mm² 6242Y twin and earth cable. It is one continuous length, so measure your cable run, allowing extra for terminations, before ordering. Other lengths are available in the length selector. Electrical installation must comply with BS 7671 and the building regulations where you live (e.g. Part P in England and Wales); if in doubt, use a qualified electrician.

product.name: Caleffi Loose Nut 6 Bar Pressure Relief Valve A311501CST
product.description: A Pressure Relief Valve is a safety component designed for unvented heating systems and serves to protect against potential overpressure risks. The Altecnic Caleffi 6 Bar activates when pressure exceeds safe thresholds and deactivates once pressure returns to a safe level. The valve automatically resets once at a safe level, maintaining system integrity without manual intervention. Featuring a loose not connection, the Altecnic Caleffi Pressure Relief Valve allows for straightforward installation and low-maintenance operation, making it a reliable and essential component of any unvented heating system, ensuring long-term performance and safety.

product.name: Caleffi 15mm O-Ring Type 6 Bar Pressure Relief Valve 312007CST
product.description:
Activating when system pressure exceeds 6 Bar, the Caleffi O-Ring Pressure Relief Valve releases excess pressure to protect the system from damage and over-pressurisation
The Caleffi 6 Bar O-Ring Pressure Relief Valve is specifically designed for unvented heating and plumbing systems to protect against excess pressure. When system pressure levels surpass 6 Bar, the valve releases surplus pressure to prevent damage to components. Once pressure returns to a safe level, the valve closes securely without manual resetting. With a 15mm connection and a reliable O-Ring seal, the Caleffi Pressure Relief Valve ensures leak-proof installation, making it an essential component for reliable and efficient system performance.

product.name: Faringdon Traditional Thermostatic Radiator Valve - Antique Brass (Angled TRV)
product.description:
The Faringdon radiator valve is a traditional thermostatic valve. It has some excellent features like the real wood wheel head top grade material brass and high quality polish to ensure it stands apart from its contemporaries. Thermostatic valves allow you to alter the temperature of your room easily by pre-selecting your desired temperature and letting the radiator automatically achieve the correct heat output. The range has a choice of desirable finishes that mean you can match your valve perfectly to your radiator.

We recommend all thermostatic radiator valves (TRV's) are installed on the flow rather than the return pipework of a radiator. When used in conjunction with a system automatic bypass valve this thermostatic valve can be installed on either the flow or return in any orientation. System automatic bypass valves are a specific building regulation requirement for all new installations and boiler upgrades. All bi-directional TRV's from any manufacturer require the bypass valve to function correctly and thus avoid radiator hammer.

product.name: Caleffi Circlip 6 Bar Pressure Relief Valve F0000412

When the pressure exceeds 6 Bar, the Caleffi 6 Bar Circlip Pressure Relief Valve releases excess pressure to protect pipes and system components from damage. Once pressure returns to a safe level, the valve closes securely, maintaining system safety without manual intervention. Its circlip design ensures a secure, durable connection, making it an essential component for preserving the integrity and longevity of heating and plumbing installations.

Compact enough for apartments and tight outdoor spaces, and yet versatile enough for full garden use, the FITT Ikon offers brilliant performance, elegant convenience and trusted FITT engineering.  The Ikon hospipe allows for safe potable water. Potable water is safe for human consumption, meaning it is safe to drink, cook with, and use for hygiene. It has undergone treatment to remove harmful contaminants, bacteria, and pollutants, and must meet strict safety standards.

product.name: Thetford Twusch Ceramic insert for Cassette Toilet C400
product.description:
Thetford Twusch Porcelain Toilet Bowl Insert - For Caravan, Campervan and Motorhome Cassette Toilets C400

Upgrade your cassette toilet with the premium Thetford Twusch Porcelain Toilet Bowl Insert. Designed to transform compatible Thetford plastic cassette toilets into a more hygienic, comfortable and home-like experience, the Twusch combines the durability and easy-clean benefits of porcelain with a lightweight design that's perfect for caravans, motorhomes and campervans.

Manufactured from high-fired porcelain with a smooth nano-sealed surface, the Twusch is naturally more resistant to staining, scratches and bacteria than standard plastic toilet bowls. Its non-porous finish makes cleaning quicker and easier while helping to reduce odours and improve overall hygiene. The optimised bowl shape also promotes more efficient flushing, reducing water consumption and extending the time between waste tank servicing.

Weighing approximately 800g, the insert delivers all the benefits of a ceramic toilet without significantly increasing the weight of your vehicle. Each insert is precision-manufactured to fit specific Thetford cassette toilet models and is straightforward to install using sanitary silicone.

Benefits:

Creates a more home-like toilet experience
Extends the service life of your existing toilet
Maintains a cleaner, fresher toilet bowl
Improves comfort and everyday usability
Better to upgrade rather than replacing the toilet

Specifications:

Material: High-fired Porcelain
Surface: Nano-sealed
Approximate Weight: 800g
Installation: Sanitary silicone (not included unless supplied with fitting kit)

product.name: Aquarius RainLux 2 Outlet Thermostatic Shower Set with Shower Head and Single Function Handset in Brushed Brass

product.name: Pegdev Detectable Mesh (Gas Pipe) Durable Underground Service Marker 200mm x 26m
product.description: Pegdev Detectable Gas Pipe Mesh is designed to provide a clear and highly visible warning for buried underground gas pipes during excavation work. Designed to be clearly visible when pulled up in an excavator bucket, the mesh provides an obvious warning to groundworkers and excavation teams. The integrated detectable wire allows the mesh to be located from the surface, providing an additional method of identifying underground gas pipe routes before or during groundworks. This durable warning mesh is suitable for contractors, builders, utility companies, landscapers and groundworkers working on construction and excavation projects. The mesh is rot resistant and manufactured from durable HDPE to withstand demanding underground conditions, providing a long-lasting solution for underground service identification. The repeated warning message provides clear visual identification when the mesh is uncovered. Conforms to BS12613:2023 and provides a practical solution for clearly marking buried gas pipe services during construction, excavation and groundworks. product.name: Natural Himalayan Salt Lamp with UK Fitting, 8-10kg, Ionizer
product.description: Using a Himalayan Crystal Salt Lamp helps replace negatively charged ions in the air, which may counteract the potential physical and mental effects of ‘electric smog.’ Each lamp comes with a UK light fitting, 1.5 meters in length, and a bulb. Instead of selling by size, we offer them by approximate weight. The size markings provided are only an estimate, as each lamp is unique.  Due to the hygroscopic properties of salt, Himalayan salt lamps and candle holders absorb moisture from the air. If your lamp is ‘sweating’ or leaking water, this is typically because it has been switched off for a prolonged period, especially in humid conditions. To remedy this, leave the lamp in strong sunlight for 4 to 5 hours and brush off any excess crystals, or wipe gently with a dry cloth. If you don't use the lamp for extended periods (such as when on holiday), disconnect the cable and remove the bulb. In humid conditions, it's recommended to place the lamp on a small tray or dish to catch any pooled water.

product.description: This bundle combines Hoses UK PVC Layflat Hose with two W4 stainless steel worm drive hose clips, providing a ready-to-use water transfer solution with everything needed to make secure, leak-free connections straight out of the box. The two included stainless steel worm drive hose clips (DIN 3017, W4 grade, 12 mm band) clamp securely onto the hose ends, ensuring a firm seal on pipes, fittings and spigots. With a 3:1 safety factor and an operating temperature of -60°C to +180°C, the clips are built to last in demanding environments without the need for additional fasteners.

Internally welded with a final coating of white enamel (RAL9016) each radiator is degreased and zinc phosphated before being coated with water-based cathophoratic paint. The final coat is applied using an epoxy polyester electrostatic powder coating system that is baked to a hard finish.

Kartell Kompact Radiators are manufactured using the latest state-of-the art technology ensuring maximum efficiency.

All radiators come complete with factory fitted top grille and side panels.

Covered by the Kartell "No Quibble Guarantee" against any manufacturing faults for 10 years.

Connections

Each K-RAD Kompact radiator has 4 x " connections as standard. " valve adaptors are available, which provides a " inch connector option to the valve without reducing performance.

Applications

K-RAD radiators are suitable for two pipe installations. For single pipe applications, it is advisable to use diversion tees in the pipework, as this will assist in obtaining design performance from the radiators.

Installation

Everything required for installation can be found within the robust packaging. Brackets are of a strong design, with open top and deep slots, which facilitates easy and secure installation. Plastic inserts seat the radiator precisely on the bracket minimizing expansion and contraction noise. The neat nickel-plated plug and vent provide a watertight joint, whilst complementing the superior finish.

4 x 1/2" connections for valves
Includes wall brackets and fixing kit with plugs, screws and air vent
Designed for two pipe heating systems. For single pipe applications it is recommended that diversion tees are used.
Nickel plated plug and vent included
White enamel powder coat finish to RAL 9016

product.name: ILCOM SLOPED RIGHT FLOOR SHOWER PROFILE LKP 11mm x 1800mm x 0.6mm Black Brushed Stainless Steel
product.description:
SLOPED Right FLOOR SHOWER PROFILE

2% reduction SUS 304 stainless steel | PVD

Sloping strips for a linear drain are the best solution if you value a professional approach to finishing your bathroom. Thanks to the shower tray strip, your shower will acquire a neat and elegant look. The slope strip is intended to mask the unsightly end of the tiles and at the same time allow a slope towards the drain without the need to cut the tiles into an "envelope". The strip forces a 2% fall, so you can be sure that your shower is perfect in every respect, both technically and visually.

Choose a practical solution:

Aesthetic finish of the track without visible silicones, no need to cut the tiles in a bag to speed up and increase the comfort of the tiler's work.

Need more arguments? The specifications of our decorative strips are another vote in favor of using them in your home: SUS 304 stainless steel; thickness appropriate to the thickness of the enamel; dimensional accuracy thanks to the use of laser cutting; durable, light-resistant and non-abrasive color obtained in the PVD process high thermal resistance; resistance to chemical agents. A product in the spirit of DIY The main advantage of our shower tray strips is their ease of installation and cutting.

Any beginner DIY enthusiast can handle them without any problems. All you need for installation is tile adhesive and silicone, while cutting can be done with an angle grinder or a saw blade. That's all you need to easily achieve a beautiful visual effect. 

length: 120/180 cm
profile width: 1.0 cm up to 3.0/4.0 cm 
Material: SUS 304 stainless steel, PVD coloring method, can be cut to size with angle grinder or metal shears
application: flooring

product.name: Water Butt Extension Kit 3/4 Inch BSP Tap Hose Barb Connector 27mm Hole Saw Drill Bit Tank Fitting Set
product.description:
This 3/4" BSP water butt extension kit provides a complete solution for installing or upgrading taps on water butts, tanks, and containers. Designed for convenience and reliability, the set includes all essential components needed to create a secure outlet connection and improve access for filling or hose attachment.

The brass-threaded extension features both male and female 3/4" BSP threads and extends approximately 50mm, making it easier to connect hoses or access water flow from containers. It can be installed into existing threaded openings or fitted into a newly drilled hole. The included securing nut and sealing washers ensure a tight, leak-resistant connection while evenly distributing pressure to reduce the risk of deformation.

The white PVC tap with 3/4" BSP male thread and hose barb allows easy control of water flow and provides a secure connection for standard hoses. Lightweight yet durable, it is suitable for both indoor and outdoor use with good resistance to corrosion and weather conditions.

A 27mm HSS hole saw drill bit is included, allowing clean and precise cutting in plastic, wood, and metal, making installation quick and straightforward even for DIY users.

Kit includes:

1 x 3/4" BSP water butt extension (male and female thread, approx. 50mm)

1 x white PVC tap with hose barb (3/4" BSP male)
1 x 27mm HSS hole saw drill bit

product.name: PP Cross 1 BSPF is a Highly Versatile Pipe Fitting Designed
product.description:
The PP Cross 1" BSPF Connector is a highly versatile pipe fitting designed to alter the direction of piping systems in 4 directions at 90 degree angles. Featuring BSP female threads, this connector ensures a secure and reliable connection to other threaded components in the system. It is ideal for applications where there is a need to navigate around obstacles, reconfigure piping layouts due to spatial limitations, and branch out in four directions, making it an essential component in various fluid transport systems.

Constructed from robust polypropylene (PP), this cross connector offers excellent durability and resistance to corrosion and harsh environmental conditions. The high-quality plastic material ensures a long service life, even in demanding applications, making it suitable for both industrial and domestic use. 

This cross connector is not only easy to install but also provides a tight, leak-proof seal, reducing the risk of fluid leakage and ensuring efficient flow management within the piping system. Its lightweight design simplifies handling and installation, while the precision-engineered threads guarantee compatibility with standard BSP fittings that have a matching thread size.

product.name: Aquarius Athens Single Vertical Column Radiator in White - 1800 x 300mm
product.description:
The Aquarius Bathrooms Athens Single Vertical Column Radiator offers a space saving heating design that complements a broad spectrum of interior styles. This vertical radiator utilizes an elegant row of smooth oval columns to guide the eye upward, making it an excellent choice for homes with limited horizontal wall space. The clean white finish functions as a beautiful neutral element, blending subtly into soft pastel or cream walls while providing a crisp contrast against deeper paint tones.

Engineered for central heating systems, this vertical radiator is constructed from high quality steel to ensure steady heat distribution across your living areas.

Why Choose a Single Layer Vertical Radiator?

This single layer vertical radiator features a single row of columns rather than a double layered layout. This construction gives the unit an exceptionally slim profile that projects minimally into your room.

It is the ideal configuration for narrow walkways, compact kitchens, or tight spaces behind doors. While it maintains a low profile footprint, its tall vertical height maximizes surface area to deliver excellent, reliable warmth to smaller or medium sized rooms.

Please note: Radiator valves are sold separately, allowing you the creative freedom to select your own custom valve shapes and finishes to complete your installation.

product.name: Aquarius Maxx Curved Single Panel Radiator in Matt Black - 1800 x 565mm
product.description:
The Aquarius Maxx Curved Vertical Single Panel Radiator is designed to provide effective heating while making practical use of wall space. With a fixed height of 1800mm and a choice of widths, it can be selected to suit different room sizes and heat requirements. White, anthracite, and black finishes are available to work across a wide range of interior styles.

The radiator incorporates curved front panels at the sides. On the far left and far right columns, the outer metal boundary sweeps backward toward the rear frame. This specific contour creates a softer transition between the front face of the radiator and the wall.

Manufactured from aluminium and designed for central heating systems, the Maxx radiator delivers rapid heat output and powerful performance when required.

Why Choose a Vertical Single Panel Design?

An upright radiator layout is highly effective at reclaiming valuable room space. By utilizing the height of your walls, you free up horizontal floor area, giving you more freedom to place furniture or clear busy walkways. Because this model uses a single row of panels, it maintains an incredibly low projection depth. It sits remarkably tight to the wall, making it an ideal choice for compact spots like kitchen alcoves, narrow hallway sections, or modern bathroom renovations.

product.description:
This Rubber Wire Reinforced Hose is a heavy-duty industrial hose designed for demanding fluid transfer applications where strength, pressure resistance, and durability are essential. Manufactured with a smooth black synthetic SBR rubber inner layer, it provides reliable flow characteristics and resistance to wear during continuous use. Reinforced with two-ply fabric cords and a steel wire spiral, the hose maintains its shape under suction and pressure, preventing collapse and improving safety during operation.

Manufactured to SAE J20R3 standard, it is ideal for suction, discharge, fluid transfer, and general-purpose industrial use. Supplied in 20 metre coils, this wire reinforced rubber hose provides a reliable solution for professional users requiring flexibility, strength, and long service life.

Compatible with electric underfloor heating. Suitable for timber and concrete floors. Backed by a 25 year warranty.

product.name: 38mm 50 Metre Clear Aquatic/Fishpond Filter, Pump or Waterfall Flexible Reinforced Hose/Pipe, Drainage Hose for Pools and Hot Tubs
product.description: This Clear PVC Corrugated Hose is a durable and flexible solution for moving water, air, or light chemicals.
